rules.name: cs-04-focus-acm-mao-bfa-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT trade_id, client_code, contract_number, derivative_type, product_code, currency, contract_month, active_lots, traded_price, settle_price, future_price, mult_factor, nc_factor, fx_nc_factor, mtm_nc, mtm_usd, mkt_value_usd, round(mtm_nc / nullif(mtm_usd, 0), 6) AS nc_per_usd, created_timestamp, updated_by FROM dbsystemuat.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table_cfs WHERE value_date = :valueDate AND client_code IN ('ACM', 'MAO', 'BFA')

SELECT trade_id, client_code, contract_number, derivative_type, product_code, currency, contract_month, active_lots, traded_price, settle_price, future_price, mult_factor, nc_factor, fx_nc_factor, mtm_nc, mtm_usd, mkt_value_usd, round((mtm_nc / nullif(mtm_usd, 0))::numeric, 6) AS nc_per_usd, created_timestamp, updated_by FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND value_date = :valueDate AND client_code IN ('ACM', 'MAO', 'BFA')
